_what_this_is_not: NOT a validation of SCHA accuracy. The exact isolated-mode criterion is the bimodality of the thermal density, which is temperature-independent because P -> exp(-V/kT) keeps a double well bimodal at any T. It cannot represent thermal stabilisation and is therefore not a finite-temperature reference.
_what_this_is: a one-sided soundness check on the screen, plus a demonstration that the temperature dependence of the screen comes from the SCHA self-consistency rather than from the shape of the well

soundness_no_manufactured_condensations.interpretation: zero means every condensation the screen reports sits on a potential that genuinely has a displaced minimum

criterion_divergence.interpretation: divergence concentrates in shallow wells and grows with temperature, which is the expected signature of the exact criterion being temperature-blind rather than of SCHA error
